errors.query:
index IN (atlas_test_events, atlas_int_events, atlas_prod_events) (Loglevel=ERROR OR loglevel=ERROR OR "ERROR at java")
| eval stage=case(index="atlas_test_events", "TEST", index="atlas_int_events", "UAT", index="atlas_prod_events", "PROD")
| rex field=_raw "(?<error>[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+(?:Exception|Error))"
| eval error=coalesce(error, class, "unknown")
| eval recent=if(_time >= relative_time(now(), "-24h"), 1, 0)
| stats sum(recent) AS n, min(_time) AS first, max(_time) AS last BY error, openshift_container_name, stage
| where n > 0 | sort - n

# How the release work of Atlas Core runs around the checklist (demo world): sign-offs, mails, Jenkins, Jira, notes, calendar.

signoff:
  roles: [QA, PO, SRE]      # who gives Go / No-Go before a gate closes
  gates: [G2, G4]           # Ready for Delivery and Go / No-Go for PROD

mail:
  from: ""
  signature: "Release Management · Atlas Core"
  rfd:
    to: [releases@atlas.example]
    cc: [partner-managers@atlas.example]
    subject: "Atlas Core {version}: Ready for Delivery"
  freeze:
    to: [releases@atlas.example]
    cc: []
    subject: "Atlas Core {version}: code freeze"
  gonogo:
    to: [releases@atlas.example, oncall@atlas.example]
    cc: []
    subject: "Atlas Core {version}: Go / No-Go for PROD"

meeting:
  attendees: [oncall@atlas.example, cm@atlas.example]
  optional: [partner-managers@atlas.example]
  subject: "Atlas Core {version}: PROD night"
  location: "Release bridge"

jenkins:
  start: "dry-run"
  start_jobs:
    - Atlas/Release/ChangedServices
  env_param: TARGET

jira:
  create: "on"

notes:
  style: table
  space: ATLASREL
  parent: 0
  title: "Release notes {version}"
  artifacts:
    - {name: orders, changelog: "https://code.atlas.example/projects/ATLAS/repos/orders/browse/CHANGELOG.md"}
    - {name: routing, changelog: "https://code.atlas.example/projects/ATLAS/repos/routing/browse/CHANGELOG.md"}
    - {name: billing, changelog: "https://code.atlas.example/projects/ATLAS/repos/billing/browse/CHANGELOG.md"}
    - {name: partner-api, changelog: "https://code.atlas.example/projects/ATLAS/repos/partner-api/browse/CHANGELOG.md", side: right}
  jql: 'fixVersion = "{version}" ORDER BY issuetype, key'

calendar:
  windows:
    - title: PROD maintenance
      kind: maintenance
      stage: PROD
      weekday: tue
      from: "22:00"
      to: "00:00"
    - title: Peak season freeze
      kind: blackout
      start: 2026-12-14
      end: 2026-12-31
    - title: Load test window
      kind: window
      stage: UAT
      weekday: tue
      from: "20:00"
      to: "22:00"

  projects: [ATLAS]
  business: [Story, Feature, Epic, Improvement]
  bugs: [Bug, Defect]

start: DEV

phases:
  - {id: freeze, en: "Freeze and checks", ru: "Фриз и проверки"}
  - {id: release, en: "Release", ru: "Релиз"}
  - {id: stages, en: "Stages", ru: "Стенды"}
  - {id: prod, en: "PROD", ru: "PROD"}

questions:
  - "Should the contract tests of the partner API block G2, or only warn?"

steps:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- week 1
  - id: code_freeze_announce
    phase: freeze
    en: "Announce the code freeze"
    ru: "Объявить код-фриз"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: tue, time: "17:00"}
    confirm: manual
    mail: freeze
    jira: delivery
    gate: G1
    actions:
      - do: "Button Jira: delivery checks: 'Delivery checks {version}' with one sub-task per team (dry-run first)"
    notes:
      - "Everything planned for {version} is merged by Tuesday 17:00. Later fixes need the release manager's approval."

  - id: freeze_job
    phase: freeze
    en: "Run the FreezeBranches job"
    ru: "Запустить джоб FreezeBranches"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: tue, time: "after 17:00"}
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/FreezeBranches
        dry_run: DRY_RUN
        params: {FREEZE: true, BRANCH: main, APPROVERS: "<release manager>"}
    notes:
      - "After the freeze, merges into main need one approval of the release manager."

  - id: release_branch
    phase: freeze
    en: "Cut the release branch release/{train}"
    ru: "Срезать ветку release/{train}"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: wed, time: "morning"}
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/CutRelease
        dry_run: DRY_RUN
        params: {FROM: main, BRANCH: "release/{train}", VERSION: "{version}"}

  - id: migration_dry_run
    phase: freeze
    en: "[Dev] Dry run of the DB migrations on a PROD copy"
    ru: "[Dev] Пробный прогон миграций БД на копии PROD"
    owner: Dev
    when: {week: 1, day: wed}
    confirm: jenkins
    only_if: "the release changes the database"
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/DB/MigrationDryRun
        params: {BRANCH: "release/{train}", SNAPSHOT: "<last night's PROD snapshot>"}
    notes:
      - "Look at the duration: a migration that locks a big table for minutes needs a plan for the PROD night."

  - id: contract_tests
    phase: freeze
    en: "[QA] Contract tests of the partner API"
    ru: "[QA] Контрактные тесты партнёрского API"
    owner: QA
    when: {week: 1, day: thu, time: "by 12:00"}
    confirm: reportportal
    notes:
      - "Breaking a partner contract is the most expensive mistake of a release: partners deploy on their own schedule."

  - id: security_scan
    phase: freeze
    en: "[SRE] Dependency and image scan"
    ru: "[SRE] Скан зависимостей и образов"
    owner: SRE
    when: {week: 1, day: thu, time: "by 12:00"}
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Security/ScanRelease
        params: {BRANCH: "release/{train}"}
    notes:
      - "No new critical finding without an accepted exception."

  - id: delivery_closed
    phase: freeze
    en: "All delivery checks closed"
    ru: "Все проверки поставки закрыты"
    owner: QA
    when: {week: 1, day: thu, time: "15:00"}
    confirm: jira

  - id: rfd
    phase: freeze
    en: "Declare Ready for Delivery"
    ru: "Объявить Ready for Delivery"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: thu, time: "16:00"}
    confirm: manual
    mail: rfd
    gate: G2
    notes:
      - "QA, PO and SRE give their Go / No-Go first. The mail goes to the release channel and the partner managers."

  - id: build_rc
    phase: release
    en: "Build the release candidate"
    ru: "Собрать релиз-кандидата"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: fri, time: "morning"}
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/BuildCandidate
        params: {BRANCH: "release/{train}", VERSION: "{version}", SIGN: true}
        takes: "40 min"
    notes:
      - "Tags every service with {version} and signs the images."

  - id: plan_deploys
    phase: release
    en: "Plan the deployments in Jira"
    ru: "Спланировать деплои в Jira"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: fri}
    confirm: jira
    jira: deploys
    actions:
      - do: "Button Jira: deploy tasks: choose the stages, their days and time slots (dry-run first)"

  - id: unfreeze
    phase: release
    en: "Lift the code freeze on main"
    ru: "Снять фриз с main"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 1, day: fri}
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/FreezeBranches
        dry_run: DRY_RUN
        params: {FREEZE: false, BRANCH: main}
    notes:
      - "From here {version} lives on release/{train}; new work goes to main."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- week 2
  - id: test_deploy
    phase: stages
    en: "Deploy to TEST"
    ru: "Деплой на TEST"
    owner: CM
    when: {week: 2, day: mon, time: "09:00-10:00"}
    confirm: jira
    reaches: TEST
    check: TEST

  - id: smoke_test
    phase: stages
    en: "[QA] Smoke on TEST"
    ru: "[QA] Smoke на TEST"
    owner: QA
    when: {week: 2, day: mon, time: "after the deploy"}
    confirm: reportportal

  - id: uat_deploy
    phase: stages
    en: "Deploy to UAT"
    ru: "Деплой на UAT"
    owner: CM
    when: {week: 2, day: mon, time: "14:00-15:00"}
    confirm: jira
    reaches: UAT
    check: UAT

  - id: edge_deploy
    phase: stages
    en: "Roll out to the edge nodes EDGE-RC and EDGE-PILOT"
    ru: "Раскатить на edge-узлы EDGE-RC и EDGE-PILOT"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 2, day: tue, time: "morning"}
    confirm: jenkins
    deploys: [EDGE-RC, EDGE-PILOT]
    check: EDGE-PILOT
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Deploy/EdgeRollout
        env: edge-pilot
        params: {VERSION: "{version}", NODES: "EDGE-RC,EDGE-PILOT", DRAIN: true}
        takes: "25 min"
    notes:
      - "The depot scanners talk to the edge nodes: a node that is down stops the sorting in its depot."

  - id: load_test
    phase: stages
    en: "[SRE] Night load test on UAT"
    ru: "[SRE] Ночной нагрузочный тест на UAT"
    owner: SRE
    when: {week: 2, day: tue, time: "20:00-22:00"}
    confirm: manual
    notes:
      - "Peak profile of a Monday morning: 3x the label prints of an average hour."

  - id: uat_logs
    phase: stages
    en: "[UAT] Logs and behaviour after the load test"
    ru: "[UAT] Логи и поведение после нагрузки"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 2, day: wed, time: "morning"}
    confirm: manual
    monitor: UAT
    gate: G3
    actions:
      - do: "Compare the response times of UAT with the evening before (Monitoring tab)"
      - do: "Every new error in the logs: find its bug, or open one"

  - id: release_notes
    phase: stages
    en: "Write the release notes"
    ru: "Написать release notes"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 2, day: wed}
    confirm: confluence
    relnotes: true

  - id: regression_full
    phase: stages
    en: "[QA] Full regression green on UAT"
    ru: "[QA] Полная регрессия зелёная на UAT"
    owner: QA
    when: {week: 2, day: thu}
    confirm: reportportal

  - id: edge_stage
    phase: stages
    en: "Deploy EDGE-STAGE"
    ru: "Деплой EDGE-STAGE"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 2, day: fri, time: "morning"}
    confirm: jenkins
    reaches: EDGE
    check: EDGE-STAGE
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Deploy/EdgeRollout
        env: edge-stage
        params: {VERSION: "{version}", NODES: "EDGE-STAGE", DRAIN: true}

  - id: prod_meeting
    phase: stages
    en: "Book the PROD night"
    ru: "Забронировать ночь PROD"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 2, day: fri}
    confirm: manual
    meeting: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- week 3
  - id: change_request
    phase: prod
    en: "Change request for PROD approved"
    ru: "Change request на PROD одобрен"
    owner: CM
    when: {week: 3, day: mon}
    confirm: jira

  - id: prod_go
    phase: prod
    en: "Go / No-Go for PROD"
    ru: "Go / No-Go на PROD"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 3, day: tue, time: "15:00"}
    confirm: manual
    mail: gonogo
    gate: G4

  - id: prod_deploy
    phase: prod
    en: "Deploy to PROD"
    ru: "Деплой на PROD"
    owner: CM
    when: {week: 3, day: tue, time: "22:00-00:00"}
    confirm: jira
    reaches: PROD
    check: PROD

  - id: shadow_deploy
    phase: prod
    en: "Deploy to SHADOW"
    ru: "Деплой на SHADOW"
    owner: CM
    when: {week: 3, day: wed, time: "09:00"}
    confirm: jira
    reaches: SHADOW
    notes:
      - "SHADOW replays a copy of the PROD traffic: the last safety net before the partners see a change."

  - id: prod_logs
    phase: prod
    en: "[PROD] Logs and behaviour after the deploy"
    ru: "[PROD] Логи и поведение после деплоя"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 3, day: wed, time: "morning"}
    confirm: manual
    monitor: PROD
    gate: G5

  - id: retro
    phase: prod
    en: "Release retro: what to change in this playbook"
    ru: "Ретро релиза: что поменять в плейбуке"
    owner: RM
    when: {week: 3, day: thu}
    confirm: manual
    optional: true

procedures:
  prod_postponed:
    - "Move the PROD night in the release calendar and in the change request."
    - "Tell the partner managers and the on-call team."

/api/file?key=playbook%3Aservice_pack.text:
# Service pack playbook of Atlas Core (demo world). A service pack has no freeze anchor: its days come from releases.yaml.

playbook: service_pack
title: {en: "Service pack", ru: "Сервис-пак"}
anchor: none
start: none

phases:
  - {id: integrate, en: "Integration", ru: "Интеграция"}
  - {id: stages, en: "Stages", ru: "Стенды"}
  - {id: prod, en: "PROD", ru: "PROD"}

steps:
  - id: sp_integrate
    phase: integrate
    en: "Fixes merged into sp/5.14"
    ru: "Фиксы влиты в sp/5.14"
    owner: Dev
    confirm: manual

  - id: sp_code_freeze
    phase: integrate
    en: "Freeze sp/5.14"
    ru: "Заморозить sp/5.14"
    owner: RM
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/FreezeBranches
        dry_run: DRY_RUN
        params: {FREEZE: true, BRANCH: "sp/5.14"}

  - id: sp_changed_units
    phase: integrate
    en: "See which services the fixes touch"
    ru: "Посмотреть, какие сервисы задеты"
    owner: RM
    confirm: jenkins
    actions:
      - job: Atlas/Release/ChangedServices
        params: {BRANCH: "sp/5.14"}
    notes:
      - "Only the changed services are deployed: a smaller blast radius than a major."

  - id: sp_rfd
    phase: integrate
    en: "Ready for Delivery"
    ru: "Ready for Delivery"
    owner: RM
    confirm: manual
    mail: rfd
    gate: G2

  - id: sp_plan_deploys
    phase: integrate
    en: "Plan the deployments in Jira"
    ru: "Спланировать деплои в Jira"
    owner: RM
    confirm: jira
    jira: deploys

  - id: sp_stage_test
    phase: stages
    en: "Deploy to TEST"
    ru: "Деплой на TEST"
    owner: CM
    confirm: jira
    reaches: TEST

  - id: sp_stage_uat
    phase: stages
    en: "Deploy to UAT"
    ru: "Деплой на UAT"
    owner: CM
    confirm: jira
    reaches: UAT

  - id: sp_regression
    phase: stages
    en: "[QA] Regression of sp/5.14 green"
    ru: "[QA] Регрессия sp/5.14 зелёная"
    owner: QA
    confirm: reportportal

  - id: sp_release_notes
    phase: stages
    en: "Release notes"
    ru: "Release notes"
    owner: RM
    confirm: confluence
    relnotes: true

  - id: sp_prod_go
    phase: prod
    en: "Go / No-Go for PROD"
    ru: "Go / No-Go на PROD"
    owner: RM
    confirm: manual
    mail: gonogo
    gate: G4

  - id: sp_prod_deploy
    phase: prod
    en: "Deploy to PROD"
    ru: "Деплой на PROD"
    owner: CM
    confirm: jira
    reaches: PROD

  - id: sp_prod_monitor
    phase: prod
    en: "[PROD] Watch the first day after the deploy"
    ru: "[PROD] Наблюдать первый день после деплоя"
    owner: RM
    confirm: manual
    monitor: PROD
    gate: G5

/api/case?id=ce73f5b91.question: Why is the regression of Billing (Main) red?

steps.note: red: Routing main, Billing main · smoke 2 of 3 green
#209: 6 failed, 6 new since the launch before
AssertionError: invoice total expected -23.10 but was -23.09
1 commit(s); b3dc8a4f447 ATLAS-2311 VAT rounding per invoice line

result.cause: The Billing tests that fail all check invoice totals, and they fail since commit b3dc8a4f447 “ATLAS-2311 VAT rounding per invoice line” in billing (Tue 17.11 15:42): the only change to the invoice code between the green launch and the red one.

evidence.text: Launch #209: the failed tests are product bugs, marked new against the launch before.

Log of “Credit note of a refunded pickup”: AssertionError: invoice total expected -23.10 but was -23.09
	at com.atlas.billing.InvoiceTotalsTest
b3dc8a4f447 ATLAS-2311 VAT rounding per invoice line changes InvoiceTotals.java.

result.ruled_out: Not the stage: the smoke is green and the other teams are green on the same night.
result.not_read: The build of billing on main: Jenkins was not read for it.

options.text: Ask the author to look at the rounding of the invoice total
options.why: The log shows a total one cent off: rounding per line instead of per invoice.
options.draft: Hi, the Billing regression on main is red since last night. The invoice totals are one cent off since b3dc8a4f447 “ATLAS-2311 VAT rounding per invoice line”. Could you have a look today? Main has to be green for the next freeze.

options.text: Revert the commit on main until it is fixed
options.why: Main stays green while the fix is made.

second.note: The time line holds: the first failing reading comes right after the change it names, and nothing else changed in between.

/api/case?id=cd8d05a7d.question: Why is the regression of Routing (Main) red?

steps.note: red: Routing main, Billing main · smoke 2 of 3 green
#209: 2 failed, 2 new since the launch before
1 commit(s); b3dc8a4f447 ATLAS-2311 VAT rounding per invoice line

result.cause: The Routing tests that fail (“Route around a closed bridge” and “Truck route over 40 t”) are marked to investigate, not as product bugs, and no routing commit landed between the green launch and the red one, so the code of Routing is not the first suspect. Both plan routes over the map service, which also times out in the logs of the stage.

evidence.text: Launch #209: the failed tests are marked to investigate.
Commits of routing since the last green launch: none.

result.ruled_out: Not a product bug found by the tests: nobody marked one, and no routing change explains them.
result.not_read: The logs of the map service: Splunk was not read in this case.

options.text: Ask the Routing team to run the two tests again once the map service answers
options.why: If they pass, it was the stage, not the code.
options.draft: Hi, two Routing tests on main are red since last night (“Route around a closed bridge” and “Truck route over 40 t”). No routing change came in, and the map service times out on the stage. Could you run them again this morning?

options.text: Open the Monitoring tab: the UAT errors are listed there
options.why: The timeouts are the likely cause.

second.note: The time line holds: the first failing reading comes right after the change it names, and nothing else changed in between.

After that: the full regression on Thursday, EDGE-STAGE and the PROD night booking on Friday, the change request on Monday, then Go / No-Go (G4) with QA, PO and SRE on Tuesday afternoon.

The one thing that can move the date is EDGE-PILOT. Ask me why the rollout failed: I can read the build log.

why did the edge rollout fail?.reply:
**Why the edge rollout of 5.15.0 failed**

EdgeRollout #311 and #312 stopped at the same point: the health check of EDGE-PILOT.
The console of #312 says: *[EDGE-PILOT] label-gateway: TLS handshake failed: certificate for edge-pilot.atlas.example expired on 2026-11-16*

So the node's TLS certificate has run out and the gateway does not start; the job rolls the node back. EDGE-RC took the release with the same job and the same parameters, so the release itself is fine.

Next: ask the SRE on call to renew the certificate, then start the rollout again from the step (dry run first).
